method: No model/network/target code execution; all selectors run before gold is read. A0 is actual build_review_context output under the documented offline byte-bound fallback; A1 is strict rendered-patch prefix fit; B is cross-file hunk round-robin; C is global existing rule/AST risk plus declaration tie-break.

input_manifest.split_definition: datasets/dev/split.json; 9 dev, 15 previously used holdout regressions, 1 excluded; all input cases must map to exactly one split member
input_manifest.budget_units: UTF-8 byte upper bound, not exact model tokens
input_manifest.rule_scanner: scan_signals(include_cross_file=False, include_linters=False); warnings retained as counts
input_manifest.rule_line_match: same normalized file and inclusive gold [start_line,end_line]; position-only proxy, never semantic TP

secondary_strategy_factors.B: round-robin by original diff file order and hunk order; complete hunks only; skip non-fitting hunk and continue
secondary_strategy_factors.C: existing scan_signals plus triage risk priority; declaration/signature heuristic tie-break; global complete-hunk ranking; removes per-file cap

summary.budget_units: UTF-8 byte upper bound, not exact model tokens
